grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: TOPIC 1.6.0
topics.description: This topic covers foundational vocabulary and descriptors, including colours as well as physical characteristics and personality traits in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.6.1 Colours
sub_topics.description: Focuses on colours as vocabulary for describing everyday objects, clothes, and food, while introducing grammar concepts such as gender and number agreement.

competencies.description: Express preferences for colours in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.6.2 Physical Characteristics and Personality
sub_topics.description: Enhances learners' communication skills and confidence as they describe characteristics of a person and objects using adjectives related to traits in French.

competencies.description: Describe someone's physical characteristics and personality in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.7.0 NUMERACY
topics.description: Numeracy refers to the ability to understand, interpret and work with numbers and mathematical concepts in daily practical communication. This topic covers Cardinal Numbers, Ordinal Numbers and Counting Money.

sub_topics.name: Sub - Topic 1.7.1 Cardinal Numbers 1-1000 in French
sub_topics.description: Covers cardinal numbers used constantly in everyday life when expressing age, quantity, prices, time, and dates.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1. 7. 2 Ordinal Numbers
sub_topics.description: Teaches ordinal numbers to help learners indicate position, ranking, and order in instructions, sequences, and narratives.

competencies.description: Demonstrate knowledge of ordinal numbers from 1 to 20 in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1. 7. 3 Counting Money
sub_topics.description: Develops life skills in budgeting, saving, and financial decision-making alongside four mathematical operations in French.

competencies.description: Apply the four mathematical operations on numbers below 100 in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.8.0 PREFERENCES
topics.description: Expressing preferences enables learners to share interests, build relationships, and discuss likes and dislikes across various social and cultural contexts.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.8.1 Likes and Dislikes
sub_topics.description: Focuses on expressions, verbs, and negative structures used to express opinions, likes, and dislikes with confidence.

competencies.description: Express likes and dislikes in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.9.0 LOCALISATION AND MOVEMENT
topics.description: Discusses the position of an object, person, or thing in a sentence, equipping learners with vocabulary, expressions, and grammatical structures needed for describing position, direction, and distance.

sub_topics.name: Sub -Topic 1.9.1 Position
sub_topics.description: Defines the location or placement of an object, person, or point in relation to its surroundings.

competencies.description: Describe the position of an object in French
State the location of a person, place or thing in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.9.2 Direction
sub_topics.description: Provides instructions and guidance on how to navigate, ask for, and give directions from one place to another.

competencies.description: Give directions to someone in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.9.3 Distance
sub_topics.description: Covers French expressions used to indicate how far or near a location is during everyday travel conversations.

competencies.description: Indicate how far or near a point is from another in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.10.0: ACCOMMODATION AND HYGIENE
topics.description: Links accommodation and hygiene with environmental awareness, enriching learners' French vocabulary regarding living spaces and maintaining personal and environmental health.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.10.1 Types of Homes
sub_topics.description: Explores modern and traditional homes, construction materials, and the names and uses of various rooms within a house.

competencies.description: Compare modern and traditional houses in French
Name different rooms and their use in a house

sub_topics.name: Sub- Topic 1.10.2 Care for the Surrounding
sub_topics.description: Focuses on hygiene behavioral changes, cleaning tools, maintaining clean surroundings, negative effects of dirty places, and personal hygiene.

competencies.description: Describe a clean and dirty place
